us_f18e.source: scenario_assumption: explicit experimental Bullpup external mount on the already-qualified F18E airframe; not a real historical Annex loadout

execution.source: English2026 PDF108/9-7: launcher-controlled radio/radar PGM; the aircraft must have a clear LOS to the target from launch until impact; general LOS loss quarters the base hit chance once (divide by 4); Glide/Direct full range from High/Medium, half from Low, quarter from VLow; no SSkim/NOE launch because motors ignite after release (neither row carries a rail-launch remark); intended target within +/-30 deg of the flight path; a PGM attack against a ship within 10nmi may skip Weapons Placement (no stationary-Base exemption is printed)
execution.continuous_los: late current-state sample after this tick controls/movement/common damage alongside SALH/EOIR; shared referee optical ray plus declared author smoke on the actual controller-to-target ray; definite loss is sticky including smoke that expires before arrival; unknown ray geometry or controller consequence persists pending_reason and holds the original terminal die
execution.controller_death: the shared ray reports the firing controller no longer airborne; the post-casualty Command control consequence is not source qualified and stays pending with the original die retained: no invented crash, takeover or auto-miss
execution.probability: existing aircombat2026 pgm table Cmd/SARH rows only; no probability cells are duplicated in this file
execution.damage: printed damage cell carried as flat damage_points plus separate additional_criticals D6 notation (root copies into WeaponDamage.extra); ship/facility common damage uses the printed flat DP through the existing damage pipeline
execution.scope: stationary allocated points only: moving-target tracking, rail-launch exceptions, control channels and the remark-letter legend are named pendings; author smoke geometry is a declared scenario experiment exercising the printed LOS-loss quarter, not a printed Command smoke rule
execution.author_carrier_scope: Direct use of the qualified us_f18e airframe with a scenario-authored physical weapon fit and actual declared store ledger. Derived experimental class aliases have no flight/operation qualifications and are not installed as new source-ready aircraft.
